definitions.gloss: to run around; to rush about
definitions.explanation: To run around energetically in various directions, or to rush from place to place handling tasks.

examples.japanese: ⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦たち→達：01551_tachi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{庭|にわ}→庭：02239_niwa⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{駆|か}け⟦{回|まわ}って→回る：01150_mawaru⟧⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: The children are running around in the garden.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{一日中|いちにちじゅう}→一日中：09519_ichinichijuu⟧{駆|か}け⟦{回|まわ}って→回る：01150_mawaru⟧⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧。
examples.english: I was rushing around all day for work.

examples.japanese: ⟦{犬|いぬ}→犬：00632_inu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{嬉|うれ}しそう→嬉しい：00822_ureshii⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{駆|か}け{回|まわ}る。

notes:
COMPOUND VERB:
⟦{駆|か}ける→駆ける：14714_kakeru⟧ (to run, to gallop) + ⟦{回|まわ}る→回る：01150_mawaru⟧ (to go around)

TRANSITIVITY:
⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive) - takes ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧ for the area being covered or ⟦で→で：00502_de⟧ for the location

USAGE:
Can describe both playful running (like children or animals) and busy rushing between tasks.

RELATED COMPOUND VERBS:
- ⟦{走|はし}り{回|まわ}る→走り回る：04608_hashirimawaru⟧: to run around (similar meaning, slightly more neutral)
- ⟦{駆|か}け{上|あ}がる→駆け上がる：06110_kakeagaru⟧: to run up
- ⟦{駆|か}け{込|こ}む→駆け込む：06112_kakekomu⟧: to rush in
